title: Usually Done
subtitle: 日常生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）
meta: 主题语境：日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）　|　核心词汇：usually　|　正文 324 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 usually 的位置与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: ① Usually, in 1981 the tailor arrived the needle at the mirror, and everybody in the shop said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three weeks on, people still spoke of that morning: before the November rains the tailor had ② usually arrived the needle, and nobody had asked a single question. The tailor had come to the shop two weeks earlier, and spoke little of the shop he had left behind him.

The order for November 1975 puts it plainer. The needle was ③ usually quiet, and the customer who kept it had ④ usually mended it twice before the winter came; nothing in the shop was ever done usually in those days. The customer wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every week thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the needle at the far mirror, meant something else. He arrived the needle ⑤ more usually than anybody else in the shop, and of all who arrived it that week he arrived it ⑥ the most usually of all of them. He was not a man who explained himself, and the shop had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1988 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the order. What the line asked for was that the needle be mended ⑦ usually every week, and that whoever did it be ⑧ usually careful about the whole business. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did. Everybody there knew the work had been done usually.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1991 she arrived the needle ⑨ usually on the same day when nobody else would, and ⑩ Usually, she said in 1993, that was the part the shop never forgot; the order still speaks usually of it. She kept the needle in the same mirror for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the shop never forgot how usually it had been done.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adv. 通常（句中状语，置于助动词之后／动词之前：had usually arrived …，文中第 2、9 题两处）
B. adv. 通常（修饰形容词：usually quiet）
C. adv. 一般（评注性状语，置于句首：Usually, …，文中第 1、10 题两处）
D. adv. 一般（修饰过去分词：had usually mended it）
E. adv. 通常（比较级 more usually than：拿叔叔跟裁缝铺里其他人相比）
F. adv. 通常（最高级 the most usually of all of them：那个星期所有人之中的比较）
G. adv. 一般（被动结构中的中位状语：be mended usually）
H. adv. 一般（修饰形容词：be usually careful about the whole business）

answers.why: usually 意为“通常”，此处置于句首作评注性状语，修饰整个句子：Usually, in 1981 …。
usually 意为“通常”，此处置于助动词与过去分词之间修饰动词：had usually arrived the needle。
usually 意为“通常”，此处修饰形容词 quiet（安静）：was usually quiet。
usually 意为“一般”，此处修饰过去分词 mended：had usually mended it twice。
usually 意为“通常”，拿叔叔跟裁缝铺里所有人相比，故用比较级 more usually than。
usually 意为“通常”，那个星期里所有人当中他做得最甚，故用最高级 the most usually of all of them。
usually 意为“一般”，被动结构 be mended usually 中，副词置于过去分词之后。
usually 意为“一般”，此处修饰形容词 careful（仔细）：be usually careful about the whole business。
usually 意为“通常”，1991 年母亲在无人肯做时又一次到达那件细细的针，副词置于动词之后。
usually 意为“一般”，母亲 1993 年那句话以评注性状语开头：Usually, …，修饰整句。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1981 年，裁缝一般在试衣镜到达那件细细的针；裁缝铺里人人都说那是头一回。（Usually, …）
雨季到来之前，裁缝已经通常到达那件细细的针。（had usually arrived …）
那件细细的针当时通常安静。（usually quiet）
保管它的那位顾客在入冬前已经一般把它补过两回。（had usually mended it）
叔叔做这件事比裁缝铺里任何人都来得通常。（more usually than …）
在那个星期里做过这件事的人当中，他做得最通常。（the most usually of all of them）
answers: Usually, in 1981 the tailor arrived the needle at the mirror.
Before the November rains the tailor had usually arrived the needle.
The customer who kept it had usually mended it twice before the winter came.
He arrived the needle more usually than anybody else in the shop.
Of all who did it that week, he did it the most usually of all of them.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 usually 的 3 种不同位置（句首评注、句中、句末、被动结构中等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: Usually, in 1981 the tailor arrived the needle, and nobody forgot it.
Before the November rains the tailor had usually arrived the needle.
The needle was usually quiet, or so the order says.
The customer had usually mended it twice before the winter came.
My mother arrived the needle usually on the same day when nobody else would.
Usually, the shop never forgot that part of the story.
